_about: Guardian sensitive-term configuration. Structure is public and reviewable; the raw term lists are intentionally MINIMAL. Per the Guardian spec, the classifier (src/agents/guardian.js) is the primary decision-maker — a wordlist alone is both too blunt (blocks innocent uses like 'cowboy with a gun') and too porous (misses paraphrase and concerning content in ordinary words). These seed lists are a fast-path/backstop and a set of illustrative signals, not an exhaustive detector. Operators may extend hard_block lists privately without touching Guardian logic.

hard_block._desc: Lane 1. Explicit content refused at ingestion; never reaches the Storyteller. Floor-level and NOT parent-toggleable.

hard_block_notes.sexual: Sexual content or sexualized language — left to the classifier; no seed terms committed to the repo.
hard_block_notes.graphic_violence: Graphic violence / gore — the classifier distinguishes this from ordinary story conflict, weapons-in-play, or mild scariness, which MUST pass.
hard_block_notes.slurs: Slurs and hate terms — left to the classifier; a raw slur dump is deliberately kept out of repo history.
hard_block_notes.self_harm_methods: Self-harm methods or instructions — classifier only.

flag_to_parent_signals._desc: Lane 2. NOT blocked. Concerning content expressed in ordinary words; surfaced privately to the parent dashboard. Seeds below are illustrative — the classifier is primary and errs toward surfacing when uncertain.
